opening.argument: The presentation offers paid entry packages ranging from 100 to 5,000 euros and expressly states that participants must refer or recruit people to make money. It describes a binary compensation plan with two teams, paying 10% of the volume on the lesser leg and allowing bonuses from people as much as 100 levels below the participant. That structure ties earnings to recruitment and network volume rather than a straightforward product sale. The material also promotes projected growth potential, while framing the financial upside as prediction- or effort-dependent. Taken together, the paid tiers, recruitment requirement, and multi-level bonus structure establish a commission-driven matrix presented as an opportunity for substantial earnings.
